Recipe: translated page title.description:
Keep the document title and the html lang attribute in step with the active locale; both are getters, so switching language rewrites them. Requires useI18n from vue-i18n and useHead from @unhead/vue.

让文档标题与 html 的 lang 属性跟随当前语言；两者都是响应式来源，切换语言即重写；需要 vue-i18n 的 useI18n 与 @unhead/vue 的 useHead。
